strings.zh: 用强大的精灵陪自己走完旅途,{NEWLINE}或者是跟喜欢的精灵一起旅行。{CLEAR}你更喜欢哪种方式呢？
strings.en: Travel with strong Pokémon at your{NEWLINE}side,{SCROLL}or journey with the Pokémon you love...{SCROLL}Which way do you prefer?

strings.zh: 人造的药物在战斗中{NEWLINE}是无法给精灵使用的,{CLEAR}一次回复太多体力的强回复药物{CLEAR}因为药性太猛,{CLEAR}在战斗中也无法使用。
strings.en: Man-made medicine can’t be given to{NEWLINE}Pokémon during battle.{SCROLL}And potent medicine that restores lots{NEWLINE}of HP at once is too strong to use in{CLEAR}battle, either.
strings.notes: Hack rule: healing items can't be used in battle.

strings.zh: 阿彻『原本华蓝道馆的馆主之位{NEWLINE}都是在馆主家族内部传承的。{SCROLL}阿彻『但是自精灵联盟成立以来,{NEWLINE}规定今后所有的新馆主上任{CLEAR}都要通过考核选拔。{CLEAR}辛苦获得精英训练家资格的我,{CLEAR}终于有机会成为华蓝道馆的馆主了！
strings.en: Curtis: Leadership of the Cerulean Gym{NEWLINE}was always passed down within the{CLEAR}Leader’s family.{SCROLL}Curtis: But since the Pokémon League{NEWLINE}was founded, every new Gym Leader has{CLEAR}to be chosen by assessment.{SCROLL}I worked hard to become an Ace Trainer,{NEWLINE}and now I finally have a shot at leading{CLEAR}the Cerulean Gym!

strings.zh: 华蓝海角的正辉是个{NEWLINE}十足的口袋妖怪迷,{CLEAR}为了能见到各种各样的口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}他就做出了用于寄存精灵的传送系统。
strings.en: Bill of Cerulean Cape is a total{NEWLINE}Pokémon maniac.{SCROLL}He wanted to see every kind of Pokémon,{NEWLINE}so he built a transfer system for{CLEAR}storing them.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV019: omission: 传送系统 = transfer system restored

strings.zh: 阿彻『华蓝洞穴的事让我明白了{NEWLINE}什么是人外有人,天外有天。{CLEAR}我不能只满足于现在的实力了,{CLEAR}还要继续锻炼变强才行。
strings.en: Curtis: What happened in Cerulean Cave{NEWLINE}taught me there’s always someone{CLEAR}stronger out there.{SCROLL}I can’t be satisfied with how strong I{NEWLINE}am now.{SCROLL}I have to keep training and get{NEWLINE}stronger.
